unlisted_practices: Integrate a deterministic, rule-based clinical safety filter between the generative AI model and the user in any AI application for headache treatment.
Default to a pre-verified passive acoustic track and notify the supervising clinician when generated audio fails the safety verifier three consecutive times.
Terminate the generative audio feed immediately and escalate an alert to the principal investigator within 24 hours when a music-induced headache exacerbation event occurs.
Operate AI-assisted music therapeutics under clinical supervision.
Monitor safety continuously through an integrated digital symptom-tracking diary that participants must log after each session.
Design digital therapeutic devices deployed in patients' homes with deterministic safety mechanisms.

screen.reason: This is a brief report/commentary proposing a transparent, rule-based clinical safety guardrail framework for AI-assisted music medicine in headache management, without empirical testing.
